about.title: About
about.description: How I work, and which jobs I turn down. I am a full-stack developer in Konya, Türkiye.
about.lead: Since November 2024 I have been a full-stack developer at BerrSoft. I write the applications and put them into production.
about.body1: When a job starts with me it stays with me to the end: I make the first architecture call, and I take the bug that turns up after launch. That leaves the client with something simple: when something breaks, nobody has to work out whose problem it is, and there is no coordination layer in between.
about.body2: Networking and security turned into decisions here. After building a ticket purchasing application I ran a penetration test against my own code; the findings rewrote its input validation and its session handling, and moved the container off root. How a system is deployed and what it exposes decides as much as how the code is written.
about.body3: The work I take is building a web application and putting it into production. I do not take paid security audits; the test above sat inside a training program. Networking and security are the layer underneath what I deliver. Outside work I spent two years organizing GDG Konya and sat on the GDG Cloud Konya core team.
about.now: I work full time at BerrSoft, and my Mathematics and Computer Science studies at Necmettin Erbakan University are still running.
about.languages: Turkish is my native language. I read and write English: documentation, repositories and the posts here. Speaking is behind reading and writing.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How this site handles visits, form messages and the measurement choice kept in your browser.
privacy.lead: What follows is not a long legal text. It says what the site takes from you and what it leaves alone.
privacy.whoBody: I am Doğan Can YILDIZ and this site is my portfolio. If you have a question about this notice, use the contact form or the email address in the footer.
privacy.storageBody: Theme preference is stored by the browser (localStorage), not as a cookie. Your measurement choice sits in the same place, under the key dcy-consent. Neither reaches me as a tracking cookie.
privacy.analyticsBody: If you allow it, visits are counted by Umami on my own server, and Umami sets no cookie. The script loads only after you say yes. Necessary storage, meaning the theme and this choice itself, does not wait on that yes, because the site needs it to work.
privacy.whatsappBody: The WhatsApp link in the footer opens a chat inside WhatsApp, which Meta runs. A message sent that way travels through Meta rather than through my own server, and Meta's own terms cover it. Email and the contact form stay available if you would rather not use it.
privacy.formBody: The form sends your name, your email, the topic you picked and your message to me through my own mail server. I use them to write back, and I neither sell them nor pass them on. The server also reads the IP address a request comes from to limit abuse; your message body and your email address are never written to the server log.
privacy.contactBody: To ask about this notice or to reach me about work, use the contact page.

consent.title: Visit counts
consent.body: This site does not use measurement cookies. Theme stays in your browser. Visit counts run on a cookieless Umami instance on my own server and load only if you allow them.
consent.manageAllowed: Visit counts are on. The script loads on this browser.
consent.manageDeclined: Visit counts are off. No measurement script loads.
consent.manageUnset: You have not answered yet, so nothing is counted.
